svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: AI Engineering roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Product Fit and Requirements: Problem framing, Choosing between AI and simpler solutions, Error costs and human oversight, Success and guardrail measures; 02 How LLMs Work: Tokens, Context windows, Sampling and variability, Common failure modes, Reasoning models; 03 Model Selection and Integration: Hosted and open-weight models, Comparing models on your own cases, The provider boundary, Handling provider errors, Model versions and retirement, When to fine-tune; 04 Prompt, Context and Interaction Design: Instructions and prompt structure, Structured output, Managing conversation context, Interaction design, User feedback, Images and documents as input; 05 Knowledge and Retrieval: Preparing the knowledge base, Chunking, Embeddings and vector search, Keyword and hybrid search, Grounding and citations, Reranking; 06 Tools and Workflows: Tool calling, Validating tool inputs and authority, Fixed workflows, Agent loops, Human approval, Model Context Protocol; 07 Evaluation and Experimentation: Building an evaluation set, Measuring each part, Model-graded evaluation, Regression testing, Online experiments; 08 Data Privacy and Governance: Mapping data flows, Data minimisation and redaction, Provider terms, retention and region, The Red Zone boundary, Logging and retention, AI governance and documentation; 09 AI Security and Safety: Threat modelling an AI feature, Prompt injection, Handling model output, Tool and data authority, Red teaming and security tests, Guardrail libraries, Model and dependency supply chain; 10 Cost, Performance and Operations: Cost per request and budgets, Latency, Caching and batch processing, Reliability and fallbacks, Observability, Releasing changes safely
svg.text: Choosing between AI and simpler solutions
Comparing models on your own cases
Every topic has a guide in the stage pages next to this image.
